prompt.project_info: Create a clean cosplay-inspired lifestyle portrait inside a premium convertible car.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman seated in a compact curled pose in a luxury convertible. She wears a full-coverage royal-blue geometric superhero-inspired bodysuit with long sleeves and matching leggings, with long dark hair and a calm contemplative expression. Do not depict or identify a specific copyrighted character.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 centered composition. Frame the adult subject within the tan leather seat structure, with her face as the primary focal point and the blue fabric texture contrasting against cognac leather. Show the open roof, car trim, and bright stone wall outside without readable logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight from above and front, soft diffused shadows, warm leather highlights, quiet serene luxury atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital lifestyle/cosplay portrait, vertical 4:5, medium depth of field, realistic anatomy and hands, visible leather grain and geometric fabric texture, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 lifestyle cosplay portrait of one generic approved adult woman seated in a compact relaxed curled pose inside a luxury convertible, full-coverage royal-blue geometric superhero-inspired long-sleeve bodysuit and matching leggings, long dark hair, calm contemplative expression, cognac tan leather seats, open roof, bright stone wall outside, centered framing, warm leather contrasted with cool blue fabric, soft natural daylight, clean premium Instagram aesthetic, realistic anatomy and hands, no specific character likeness, no logos, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, specific copyrighted character likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subject, unreadable text, logos, watermark

assets.name: superhero-girl-luxury-car reference
assets.usage: Match the centered seated composition, tan leather and royal-blue color contrast, full-coverage cosplay styling, daylight, and luxury convertible setting while keeping the adult identity and character concept generic and replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve composition, seat geometry, color palette, fabric texture, lighting, and calm mood. Keep the person, costume details, car, background, and environment replaceable. Use superhero-inspired styling only; do not reproduce a named character or logo.
